disclaimer.zh: 本案例借鉴巴菲特的长期投资思想。剧情、价格和交易过程经过教学简化，不是历史行情回放。所有金额均为模拟币。本例暂不计手续费、税费、分红和现金利息。
disclaimer.en: Inspired by Buffett’s long-term investing ideas. Story, prices and trades are simplified teaching assumptions, not a historical replay. All amounts are simulated credits. Fees, taxes, dividends and cash interest are excluded.

title.zh: 审视一家企业——可口可乐

text.zh: 你正在进行一项价值投资练习。面对短期经营数据的波动，你需要先判断：哪些信息影响企业长期竞争力，哪些信息还不足以支持结论？
text.en: In this value investing exercise, decide which short-term operating changes affect long-term competitiveness and which are insufficient for a conclusion.

mentor.zh: 先收集品牌、渠道和长期现金流的证据，再判断企业价值。单个季度的数据只是研究的起点。
mentor.en: Gather evidence about the brand, distribution and long-term cash flow before judging value. One quarter is only a starting point.

label.zh: 继续查看品牌、渠道与长期现金流，再进入估值分析。
label.en: Study the brand, distribution and long-term cash flow, then examine valuation.

label.zh: 仅依据本季度的营收变化，结束进一步研究并选择观望。
label.en: Stop further research and wait solely because of this quarter’s revenue change.

text.zh: 保守估值：125 模拟币／份。当前教学价格：100 模拟币／份。最低安全边际要求：20%。本次建仓上限：初始资金的 40%。安全边际＝（125－100）÷125＝20%。请选择建仓方案，通过本案例的规则检查后执行模拟交易。
text.en: Conservative value: 125 credits/share. Teaching price: 100. Required margin of safety: 20%. Position limit: 40% of initial funds. Margin = (125 − 100) / 125 = 20%. Choose a plan; the simulation checks the rules before trading.

mentor.zh: 好企业也需要合适的价格。检查价格是否满足要求，同时遵守事先设定的仓位规则。
mentor.en: A good company still needs a suitable price. Check the valuation requirement and follow the agreed position limit.

label.zh: 考虑到公司质量较好，先买入 80 份，再根据后续情况调整。
label.en: Buy 80 shares because the company is good, then adjust later.

label.zh: 按当前规则买入 40 份，保留 6,000 模拟币现金。
label.en: Follow the rule: buy 40 shares and retain 6,000 credits in cash.

title.zh: 股价下跌，重新检查判断依据
title.en: Recheck the evidence after a price decline

text.zh: 市场波动使教学价格降至 79.50。题设已复核：企业的长期竞争力和现金流假设没有发生不利变化，当前也没有触发本案例预设的退出条件。你需要依据原有规则作出决定。
text.en: The teaching price falls to 79.50. In this scenario, long-term competitiveness and cash flow assumptions have not deteriorated and no predefined exit condition is triggered. Decide using the original rules.

mentor.zh: 价格变化需要关注，也需要解释。先检查原来的判断依据和退出条件，再决定是否行动。
mentor.en: Notice price changes, but explain them. Check the original evidence and exit conditions before acting.

label.zh: 复核基本面和退出条件，按本案例的既定规则继续持有。
label.en: Recheck fundamentals and exit conditions; continue holding under the case rules.

label.zh: 仅因为价格下跌，立即卖出全部 40 份。
label.en: Immediately sell all 40 shares solely because the price fell.

text.zh: 在这条教学路径中，一段时间后，企业经营表现支持了原先的判断，教学价格变为 194.00。请回顾你的研究、估值和仓位安排，并思考什么信息可能推翻最初的判断。
text.en: On this teaching path, later operating results support the original judgment and the teaching price becomes 194.00. Review your research, valuation and position size. What information could overturn the original thesis?

mentor.zh: 这次结果为正，但一次盈利不能单独证明方法有效。复盘时，请同时检查判断依据、规则执行和没有发生的风险。
mentor.en: This result is positive, but one profit cannot prove a method works. Review the evidence, rule execution and risks that did not materialize.

wait_quarter.zh: 观望可以是合理决定，但本次判断主要依赖单季变化，尚未补充长期竞争力和现金流证据。请在下一次尝试中完善研究依据。
wait_quarter.en: Waiting can be reasonable. This decision relied on one quarter without long-term competitiveness or cash flow evidence. Improve the evidence in your next attempt.

buy_80.zh: 该方案超过了本次练习预设的 40% 仓位上限。企业质量与仓位管理需要分别判断，请重新审视资金安排。
buy_80.en: This plan exceeds the exercise’s 40% position limit. Company quality and position size are separate decisions. Reconsider the allocation.

sell_fear.zh: 这次卖出没有对应本案例事先设定的退出条件。卖出本身并不必然错误；如果基本面恶化或触发风险规则，退出可以合理。本次练习需要补充的是决策依据。
sell_fear.en: This sale did not match the predefined exit conditions. Selling is not inherently wrong: deteriorating fundamentals or triggered risk rules can justify it. This exercise calls for a decision supported by evidence.
